purpose: Audit targets only; NOT an implementation or parity certification
evidence_policy: A PASS requires exact source SHA, toolchain and target, successful executed Atto guest, rejection tests, and inspectable run artifact. Host-model-only evidence is not a PASS.

features.name: Algebraic data types
features.aot_strategy: closed tagged sums/products; precomputed ABI layouts

features.name: Pattern matching
features.aot_strategy: exhaustiveness and guard ordering compiled to finite decision trees

features.name: Type inference
features.aot_strategy: static local/bidirectional inference; no runtime inference engine

features.name: Zero-cost abstractions
features.aot_strategy: specialize or devirtualize where proven; no blanket zero-overhead claim

features.name: Memory safety without GC
features.aot_strategy: ownership/borrowing plus bounded actor arenas and deterministic release

features.name: Immutability by default
features.aot_strategy: val/let and mut separated; compile-time const distinct

features.name: Lightweight concurrency
features.aot_strategy: AOT task/frame layouts and bounded scheduling

features.name: Actor model
features.aot_strategy: typed mailbox/CONTROL ABI and actor isolation without dynamic compilation

features.name: Structured concurrency
features.aot_strategy: lexical child lifetimes, cancellation, joins, fault propagation

features.name: Async/await
features.aot_strategy: compile state machines and suspension effects ahead of time

features.name: Traits/typeclasses
features.aot_strategy: closed-world witness tables or static specialization; no runtime instance synthesis

features.name: Extension methods
features.aot_strategy: resolve at compile time under explicit import and ambiguity rules

features.name: Generics
features.aot_strategy: monomorphization or precompiled dictionary dispatch with bounded specialization closure

features.name: Higher-order functions
features.aot_strategy: AOT function pointers and typed callable ABI

features.name: Closures
features.aot_strategy: compile environment layouts and ownership/capture plans

features.name: Iterators
features.aot_strategy: finite typed iterator/adaptor pipelines and lifetime checks

features.name: Lazy evaluation
features.aot_strategy: AOT thunk/iterator state and bounded memoization lifetime

features.name: Destructuring
features.aot_strategy: static shape/variant binding plans; exact evaluation order

features.name: Null safety
features.aot_strategy: Option<T> and explicit omittable argument separation; no implicit null

features.name: Result/Either errors
features.aot_strategy: typed Result/Option and ? early exit with ownership/effect checks

features.name: Compile-time metaprogramming
features.aot_strategy: sandboxed deterministic, bounded compiler-time evaluation; emitted IR frozen

features.name: Macros
features.aot_strategy: hygienic, bounded compile-time expansion with diagnostics/source maps

features.name: Refinement/dependent types
features.aot_strategy: compile-time decidable constraints first; undecidable/general proofs research only

features.name: Hot code reloading
features.aot_strategy: load separately AOT-built artifacts, version ABI and generation-fence actor state

features.name: Built-in concurrency primitives
features.aot_strategy: typed channels, select, supervision and cooperative cancellation

syntax_patterns.atto_direction: match/on with exhaustive arms, compile checked
match<T> expression with return/effect inference
nominal tagged enums/ADTs with static payload layouts
typed enum variant payloads
pattern dispatch resolved with first-match and arity gates
lambda literals with unambiguous call grammar; optional sugar deferred
typed callable blocks and iterators
|> forward functional pipeline
|> pipeline and named composition helper; do not conflate actor pipe
typed iterator/query combinators; syntax proposal separate
nominal interfaces/traits with static witness requirements
closed witness resolution at compile time
statically checked structural shape projection
sealed class/interface exhaustiveness
structural satisfaction only when statically provable; ambiguity fails closed
Channel<T>, readch/writech, << and >> typed IO
receives/emits-or-sends typed contracts; supervisor CONTROL separate
spawn Actor() with statically known actor type
task scopes, joins and cancellation at suspension boundaries
susp/suspends and await with compiled continuation frames
copy!/take!/share!/borrow! with static loan discipline
actor arena/allocator capability; no universal GC dependency
deterministic cleanup and drop on all control-flow exits
defer/recover ordering and completion/exception safety
Result<T,E>, Option<T>, ? typed early exit

non_negotiable: No runtime AttoLang source compiler or JIT required
No eval of runtime-generated AttoLang code
No runtime generic specialization or macro expansion
Fail-closed backend admission: unsupported constructs emit no executable artifact
Externally built and signed AOT plugins are distinct from JIT
No claiming parity from syntax parse, host models, or source-free shims
